mapper.sql: JOIN t_test_version tv ON tv.id = ( SELECT current_tv.id FROM t_test_version current_tv WHERE current_tv.test_id = t.id AND current_tv.version_status = 4 AND current_tv.deleted = 0 ORDER BY current_tv.published_at DESC, current_tv.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS test_id, CAST(tv.id AS CHAR) AS version_id, t.test_type, CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS category_id, c.category_name, tv.title, tv.cover_url, tv.draw_question_count AS question_count, tv.estimated_minutes
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS category_id, c.category_name FROM t_category c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_no DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT
FROM t_test t JOIN t_category c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE t.home_display = #{homeDisplay} AND t.status = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.home_sort DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS test_id, CAST(tv.id AS CHAR) AS version_id, t.test_type, CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS category_id, c.category_name, tv.title, tv.cover_url, tv.detail_image_url, tv.draw_question_count AS question_count, tv.estimated_minutes, tv.description FROM t_test t JOIN t_category c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE t.id = #{testId} AND t.status = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
